title: media.processed v1 payload
description: The media is ready to serve. Recorded once per media, in the same transaction that marks it ready (a replayed step records nothing). For a transcoded video (5.2, additive fields): purpose, the HLS renditions made (short side in px, never above the source), duration and the top rendition's size; variants then lists poster, hls and mp4 (when the MP4 fallback is on). Tara Intelligence WP 2.6b (additive, optional): has_audio and fps from the probe, sent only when the probe recorded them. Tara Intelligence WP 4c.5-B3 / 4c.6-B3 (additive enum values): an image also lists display_640 and display_1280 (WebP, longest side, never upscaled: a size the image does not reach is not listed, and an animated image has none); a transcoded video lists poster_480 when its poster reaches a 480 px short side.
